summary: Fachprüfungsordnung of 29 April 2014 as amended on 30 May 2017 (section 8). The 30 June 2015 amendment is cited in that order but is not in the sources, and the 2017 amendment does not change the 2014 focus lists. Two 12-ECTS specialization modules Umwelttechnik A and B, each in one sub-field, with B a sub-field not already chosen for A and no module counted in both. Supplements total 18 ECTS: at least 6 from Umweltingenieurwesen, at least 6 from Fachübergreifende Methoden und Inhalte, and 6 more from either, with neither area above 12. Also 6 ECTS mathematics/natural sciences, 6 ECTS key competencies (interdisciplinary), 6 ECTS environmental law, and the 30-ECTS thesis, based on an approved study plan. Industrial Ecology and Sustainable Engineering is a legal B focus but is not offered this semester.
